rationale: Each entry in trials already represents one planned logical trial and is identified by trial_digest. Attempt counts belong to runtime physical-execution and recovery records, where retries occur; keeping one in the immutable plan duplicates or prematurely encodes that state.
alternatives: Keep only if a trial can contain multiple distinct planned logical attempts that share a trial_digest; in that case the digest contract must explicitly include this number.
simplestChoice: Remove it; use the trial entry and trial_digest as the planned logical-trial identity.
